name: Intercom
whatYouLose: Reliable real-time messaging and identity across web and mobile
Inbox routing, SLAs, bots, knowledge, campaigns, and reporting
A large integration and support operations ecosystem
prompt: Build a lightweight support request inbox for a small product. Add an embeddable contact widget that creates a conversation, email notifications for new messages, a password-protected team inbox, assignment, status, internal notes, tags, saved replies, searchable history, and a simple help-center page. Use polling rather than promising perfect real-time chat, store data in SQLite, protect all public endpoints with rate limits and honeypots, and use Astro SSR with vanilla JavaScript. Include export, retention controls, and tests.
notes: A contact inbox is attainable. Intercom's full real-time customer platform is far outside one prompt and carries operational risk.
